The man has chiseled features and moves with a grace that suggests someone athletic and possibly a little dangerous. You ponder your options, you can always say that your husband/wife/boyfriend or girlfriend is sitting there, but it would be a lie. 

"No." you say, nodding to the seat, "Please."
